blockModal.title: Block this user?
blockModal.help: Blocking limits friend requests, starting 1:1 chats and group chat selection. Existing chat rooms are not automatically deleted. Automatic friend removal is outside the scope of this feature.

blockListModal.title: Blocked users
blockListModal.description: Blocked users are hidden from your friends list. View and unblock them here.
blockListModal.emptyDescription: Users you block will appear here.

unblockModal.title: Unblock this user?
unblockModal.help: Unblocking may allow friend requests, chats and group selection again. If the friendship was removed, a new friend request may be needed.

deleteModal.title: Remove this friend?
deleteModal.notice: Removing a friend does not delete existing chat rooms. They will no longer appear in your friends list or as an option for starting 1:1 chats and selecting group members.
